compiled:
📰 General

Avatar: The Way of Water Sequels Dominates Box Office, Shattering Records •

“Avatar: The Way of Water” sequel, “Avatar: The Way of Water,” achieved a significant box office milestone on New Year’s Eve, generating $8.1 million in domestic ticket sales. The film’s continued success marks another holiday season record for James Cameron and Disney, solidifying its position as a major cinematic franchise. Overall, “Avatar: The Way of Water” achieved a 2025 gross of $8.9 billion, surpassing previous records. The film’s performance highlights the ongoing popularity of the Pandora universe and its immersive storytelling.

🌍 World

Protests in Iran Turn Deadly: Two Dead in Security Force Clashes •

Demonstrations across Iran have escalated into violence, with at least two individuals confirmed dead following clashes with security forces. The unrest, now in its fifth day, is rooted in widespread public anger over rising living costs. Reports indicate confrontations occurred between protesters and security personnel, according to both Fars news agency and the Hengaw human rights group. Authorities have not yet released official casualty figures, and the situation remains tense as demonstrations continue.

🦅 US

Rain-Soaked Rose Parade Kicks Off New Year in Pasadena, Marking Decades •

The 137th Rose Parade commenced on Colorado Boulevard in Pasadena under persistent rainfall on Thursday morning. Michael Brooks secured his family’s front-row seats, utilizing a daisy-printed umbrella to protect them from the downpour. The unusual weather presented a unique spectacle for spectators and participants alike. Organizers noted the rain as a historic element of the parade’s opening.

💰 Business

Turkmenistan Legalizes Cryptocurrency Mining and Exchanges – A Surprising Shift •

Turkmenistan, a nation known for its isolation and reliance on natural gas, has recently authorized cryptocurrency mining and exchange activities. The government’s decision marks a significant departure from its previously strict control over financial transactions. The move is reportedly aimed at diversifying the country’s economy and attracting investment. Initial reports suggest the government is establishing regulatory frameworks for these activities within its borders.

💻 Technology

Xbox Prepares for 2026: Key Games and Hardware Could Define the Future •

Following a mixed 2025, Xbox is anticipating significant developments in 2026, primarily driven by the release of highly anticipated titles. The company plans to leverage the next-generation Xbox Series X|S hardware to showcase these games effectively. Specifically, the launch of several major AAA titles is expected to be a central focus for the console. Microsoft is also aiming to solidify its strategy in cloud gaming and subscription services during this period.

🎭 Entertainment

Sadie Sink’s Vecna Memories Reveal a Strikingly Familiar Face in Stranger Things •

In the latest episode of Stranger Things, Sadie Sink portrays a teenage version of Winona Ryder’s Joyce Byers, sparking immediate recognition among viewers. The flashback sequence shows Max investigating Vecna’s past at Hawkins High, utilizing recordings of Joyce’s frantic calls. Production designers employed a meticulously crafted set and wardrobe to evoke the 1985 era, mirroring the original series’ aesthetic. The casting choice and visual recreation were deliberate, aiming to heighten the emotional impact of the storyline.

🏅 Sports

Ivan Demidov Crowned NHL Rookie of the Month for Stellar December Performance •

Ivan Demidov, a right wing for the Montreal Canadiens, has been recognized as the NHL’s Rookie of the Month for December. He achieved this honor by leading all rookies with 4 goals and 10 assists, totaling 14 points in 15 games. Demidov’s performance surpassed that of Beckett Sennecke, who finished second with 5 goals and 6 assists. The Canadiens right wing’s impressive statistics highlight his immediate impact on the league.

🔬 Science

Solo Backpacker Reveals Key Reason He’s Abandoning the Bear Can •

A solo backpacker on the Appalachian Trail has decided to forgo using a bear can for food storage. The hiker encountered black bears during a previous trip, experiencing a frightening encounter despite the bears initially fleeing upon being yelled at. He found the bear can’s size and weight impractical for his travels. Instead, he is opting for a bear bag, citing its lighter weight and greater maneuverability while hiking.

🩺 Health

Facial Wrinkles, Particularly Crow’s Feet, Strongly Linked to Increased Dementia Risk •

Research conducted in China has identified a correlation between visible facial wrinkles and the likelihood of developing Alzheimer’s disease or other forms of dementia. Scientists observed that individuals exhibiting signs of premature aging, specifically crow’s feet, demonstrated a significantly elevated risk of diagnosis. The study suggests that the presence of wrinkles may reflect underlying biological changes associated with the disease process. Further investigation is underway to understand the precise mechanisms connecting wrinkle appearance and dementia development.
